Listed at {{height|ft=6|in=6}}, he could play both [[shooting guard]] and [[small forward]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida Gators]]. ==Early years== Walsh was born in [[Philadelphia]]. He attended Germantown Academy, a private preparatory school in [[Fort Washington, Pennsylvania]], where he played high school basketball for the [[Germantown Academy|Germantown Academy Patriots]]. ==College career== Walsh accepted an athletic scholarship to attend the [[University of Florida]] in Gainesville, Florida, where he played for coach [[Billy Donovan]]'s [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida Gators basketball]] team for three seasons from 2002 to 2005. As a junior, Walsh suffered torn left ankle ligaments and missed several games,[https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/columns/story?id=1959760 Walsh suffered torn ankle ligaments] but recovered to lead the Gators to the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC) tournament championship and the second round of the [[2005 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament]]. ==Professional career== The [[Miami Heat]] originally signed Walsh as an [[undrafted]] [[free agent]] out of the University of Florida in 2005. He was then waived on November 18, 2005, after playing in two [[NBA]] regular season games. In the 2006 NBA preseason, he was signed by the [[New Jersey Nets]], and they then released him in October. In the 2006–07 season, Walsh played with [[Olympia Larissa BC|Olympia Larissa]] in the [[A1 Ethniki|Greek League]], having a successful year for both the team and himself. He was considered one of the most valuable players in the Greek League that year, and he was also the second best scorer of the competition, averaging 17.8 points per game.[http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=42685 Matt Walsh, el hombre afortunado] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120925221501/http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=42685 |date=September 25, 2012 }}, ACB.com. {{in lang|es}} Walsh also played with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] in the [[NBA Summer League]] in 2007, and he later signed a one-year contract with [[Bàsquet Manresa]] of the [[Asociación de Clubs de Baloncesto|Spanish ACB League]].[http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=41454 El alero Matt Walsh cierra la plantilla del Ricoh Manresa para la ACB 07-08] League]] club [[Union Olimpija]].[http://www.sportando.net/eng/europa/euroleague/3873/union_olimpija_tabs_matt_walsh.html Union Olimpija tabs Matt Walsh.] In February 2010, he joined the Greek League club [[Aris BC|Aris]].[http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/ulebcup/home/on-court/transactions/eurocup-2009-10/i/67153/3695/aris-bsa-2003-adds-matt-walsh Eurocupbasketball.com – ARIS BSA 2003 adds Matt
